seoDescription: Learn what the Fondue emoji 🫕 really means.

longForm.overview:
The 🫕 Fondue emoji was added in Unicode 13 (2020) and is drawn as a black or dark pot with a wooden handle and visible melted cheese or chocolate inside. The visual cue reads instantly as fondue-coded reference, melted-cheese default, or the visible 'dipping sauce' tag. By 2026 🫕 has become the go-to emoji for the fondue reaction, the visible melted-cheese default, and the cozy-coded reaction in close-friends and family chats.

In modern chat 🫕 does very specific work. People send it as a literal fondue reference, as the visible 'dipping sauce' tag, or as the cozy-coded default. The dark pot with melted contents and a handle is the visual cue that the read is fondue-coded. Writers should pick 🫕 when the read is fondue or visible 'cozy meal' energy, and avoid it when the read is pan — 🥘 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
🫕 lands on a friend's 'fondue night' message, in a work channel where someone is signaling cozy-coded energy, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is signaling 'cozy date'. The dark pot with melted contents and a handle anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 🫕 reads as the universal fondue default and the visible 'dipping sauce' tag. On X the emoji punctuates food-coded and cozy-coded tweets. The emoji pairs with 🥖 for the layered fondue-and-bread stack and with 🧀 for the layered fondue-and-cheese pair stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 🫕 in any context where the read is pan of food. The fondue pot implies melted cheese or chocolate, not regular cooking. Avoid 🫕 in formal contexts where the food-coded read lands as out-of-place.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 🫕 on a cozy-coded message, mirror with another 🫕 or 🧀 to match the energy. The fondue chain reads as solidarity.

If 🫕 lands as the melted-cheese-coded default, reply with another 🫕 or 🥖. And if you want to send 🫕 yourself, pair it with the moment so the fondue-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 🫕 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 🫕 means fondue-coded reference, visible melted-cheese energy, or the cozy-coded reaction. The dark pot with melted contents and a handle is the visual cue that the read is fondue-coded.

faqs.question: Is 🫕 flirty?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. 🫕 reads as flirty-coded in a dating thread combined with 'cozy date night' content.

faqs.question: What does 🫕 mean from a girl?
faqs.answer: From a girl or anyone, 🫕 carries the same fondue-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 🫕 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, 🫕 is the default sticker on cozy-coded captions and date-night-coded story overlays.
